result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on prior findings SV-03-001 and SV-03-002 plus directly touched production/test surfaces. The production async maintenance path now constructs a lower-band compression scheduler and passes it to chunk maintenance, and the manual calibration artifact now contains a representative transcript, detailed output, brief output, and review notes. However, the required `npm run verify-all` gate failed on a touched lower-band async scheduling test, so the story is not ready for handoff.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `async-thread-run-service.ts` now imports `LowerBandCompressionService` and `PiCodexLowerBandCompressionProvider`, exposes lower-band compression dependencies, creates a scheduler in `createLowerBandCompressionScheduler`, and passes it into `updateChunkState` via `lowerBandCompressionScheduler` at lines 1130-1138. The new production-path test in `tests/thread/async-thread-run-service.test.ts` exercises `maintainAsyncThread`, observes detailed and brief provider calls without waiting on model latency, and verifies both artifacts persist.

The new artifact `manual-calibration-2026-05-18.md` records the provider path, model lane, prompt versions, representative conversation-only transcript, generated detailed output, generated brief output, and review notes, satisfying the story's manual calibration evidence requirement.

newFindings.title: Full verification gate is failing on the touched async lower-band scheduling path
newFindings.evidence: `npm run verify-all` failed while running its nested service suite. The failing test was `tests/thread/lower-band-compression-service.test.ts` test `chunk close schedules async detailed and brief lower-band generation without waiting on provider latency`; the background run logged `Async lower-band compression run failed. {"threadId":"thread-lower-band-schedule","chunkId":"chunk-001","error":"STORE_UNAVAILABLE: thread mutation failed."}` and the assertion at `tests/thread/lower-band-compression-service.test.ts:364` saw `closedChunk.lowerBand?.brief?.status` as `undefined` instead of `ready`. A targeted rerun of `node --import tsx --test tests/thread/lower-band-compression-service.test.ts` passed, so this appears nondeterministic, but the required full gate result is still failed and the failure is on Story 3's directly touched async persistence surface.

additionalObservations: No material fake adapter, mock path, shim, placeholder fallback, or non-real production execution path was found in the follow-up production-path audit. Test fakes remain confined to test-injected provider boundaries.

`createLowerBandCompressionScheduler` intentionally returns no default provider when `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` is set unless a test injects one; this is consistent with keeping default service tests from unexpectedly crossing the GPT OAuth boundary while production defaults to `PiCodexLowerBandCompressionProvider` when `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` is absent.

The targeted lower-band compression suite passed after the full-gate failure, which narrows the remaining issue to gate stability or a race in async lower-band artifact persistence rather than a consistently broken direct service path.
